paper_title: DLP Dynamic Layerwise Pruning in Large Language Models
caption_used: Comparison of per-output and per-layer perplexity at different sparsity rates using a logarithmic scale. Both pruning configurations maintain comparable perplexity below 10^1 for sparsity rates up to 50%, after which values begin to diverge. At 60% sparsity, the Per-Output configuration reaches approximately 15 while Per-Layer remains near 10^1. The most pronounced separation occurs at 70%, where Per-Output perplexity climbs to roughly 50 while Per-Layer reaches approximately 25. At 80% sparsity, both configurations approach 10^3, with Per-Output exhibiting marginally higher perplexity than Per-Layer at this extreme.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата сравнява perplexity (Per-Output и Per-Layer) при различни проценти разредкост (Sparsity Rate). Хоризонталната ос представя процентите на разредкост, вариращи от 10% до 80%, с интервали от 10%. Вертикалната ос е обозначена като "Perplexity" и използва логаритмична скала от 10^0 до 10^3. Стълбовете са подредени по реда на нарастваща разредкост. Има два типа стълбове, всеки от които представлява различна конфигурация: "Per-Output" (синьо) и "Per-Layer" (оранжево). Например, за 10% разредкост, perplexity при "Per-Output" е около 1.5, докато при "Per-Layer" е около 2. При 80% разредкост, perplexity при "Per-Output" е близо до 10^3, а "Per-Layer" е малко по-под 10^3. По-високите стойности се наблюдават при по-висока разредкост и при конфигурацията "Per-Output".
model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图展示了不同稀疏率下每输出和每层的困惑度。 横坐标为稀疏率，标签为“Sparsity Rate”，范围从10%到80%，以10%的增量排列。纵坐标为“Perplexity”，采用对数刻度，刻度范围从10^0到10^3，刻度线刻度间隔为10^0, 10^1, 10^2, 10^3。图中呈现了两组柱状图，一组蓝色代表“Per-Output”，另一组橙色代表“Per-Layer”。柱状图排列在横坐标上，按稀疏率的顺序排列。在10%的稀疏率下，Per-Output为大约1，Per-Layer为大约2。随着稀疏率增加到80%，Per-Output达到了大约1000，而Per-Layer达到了大约800。所有Per-Output柱状图的高度都小于对应的Per-Layer柱状图。柱状图未在视觉上加以着重强调。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of per-output and per-layer perplexity values across varying sparsity rates. The horizontal axis represents sparsity rate, labeled as "Sparsity Rate," and is divided into categories of 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, and 80%. The vertical axis is labeled "Perplexity" and uses a logarithmic scale where tick labels are 0.1, 1, 10, 100, and 1000. Two sets of bars are displayed, one representing "Per-Output" and colored blue, and the other representing "Per-Layer" and colored orange. The bars are sorted in ascending order by sparsity rate. The shortest blue bar, corresponding to a 10% sparsity rate, has an approximate value of 1, while the tallest blue bar, at 80% sparsity, has an approximate value of 1000.  Similarly, the shortest orange bar (10% sparsity) has an approximate value of 1, and the tallest orange bar (80% sparsity) also has an approximate value of 1000. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
model_annotations.German: Das vorliegende Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Per-Output- und Per-Layer-Komplexität bei verschiedenen Sparsity-Raten. Die horizontale Achse stellt die Sparsity-Rate auf einer linearen Skala dar, wobei die Werte in Prozent von 10 % bis 80 % in Schritten von 10 % aufgeführt sind. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Perplexity dar, wobei eine logarithmische Skala mit einem Wertebereich von 10^-1 bis 10^3 verwendet wird und die Tick-Beschriftungen in Potenzen von 10 angeordnet sind. Zwei Balkenreihen sind vorhanden: Per-Output, dargestellt in Blau, und Per-Layer, dargestellt in Orange. Die Per-Output-Balken haben die Werte 1.3, 1.8, 2.3, 2.8, 3.2, 3.7, 50 und 1000, während die Per-Layer-Balken die Werte 1.2, 1.7, 2.2, 2.7, 3.1, 3.6, 25 und 1000 haben. Die Balken sind in aufsteigender Reihenfolge der Sparsity-Rate angeordnet. Der Balken für 70 % Sparsity Rate ist für die Per-Output-Konfiguration visuell hervorgehoben.
